github_size_analysis.gitattributes: The Deligne source-tree path is already binary-preserving and does not use Git LFS.
github_size_analysis.operational_note: The three chunks will trigger GitHub large-file warnings and add about 288 MB of already-compressed history, but each is below the ordinary Git hard ceiling. Push only once after exact staged-blob verification, then anonymously read back all three chunks and verify byte-for-byte reassembly. The existing D031-ready source tree already contains a 72,884,015-byte public-safe archive, so binary evidence in this path is an established pattern.
github_size_analysis.zenodo_rule: Reconstruct and publish the single 288,243,339-byte provenance carrier inside the consolidated Zenodo provenance/archive workflow; do not publish the three chunks as the compact Zenodo top-level interface.

planned_zenodo_integration.lineage_rule: Create exactly one successor from the anonymously verified D031 successor record; never fork from the older D013 record once D031 is public.
planned_zenodo_integration.source_zip_rule: Rebuild deterministically from the D031 source tree plus the exact D017 public-safe payload and D017 integration receipts; replay every member. Exact size/hash/member count are build outputs, not assumed by this plan.
planned_zenodo_integration.provenance_rule: Consolidate inherited D031 provenance with the exact reconstructed D017 public provenance carrier, gate, packet and integration receipts; rebuild deterministically and replay every member.
planned_zenodo_integration.size_rule: The documented ordinary record limit, not 500 MB, governs the cumulative successor. The post-D017 source and consolidated-provenance archives may each exceed 500 MB; exact aggregate size must be checked against the current documented record limit before upload.
planned_zenodo_integration.publication_rule: After all deterministic build and audit gates pass, publish the successor, anonymously read back the six-file inventory and every byte, verify the concept resolver, then cross-link the exact Git commit and Zenodo record/version DOI in both public surfaces.
